correctness.rationale: The inspected verifier exhausts every weak composition into the six rankings, uses two independent Coombs implementations, tests every present type and every positive homogeneous abstention size, and independently reconstructs events from post-abstention profiles. It yields zero standard events through nine voters, twelve at ten, 2412 unique-outcome ten-voter profiles out of 3003 total, exactly one profitable event per bad profile, and two six-element orbits. Its separate exactly-two search gives zero through twelve and eighteen at thirteen in three six-element orbits. A fresh independent reimplementation reproduced the same boundary counts. Direct checking of both normalized ten-voter representatives confirms the winner change.
residual_risks: The minimality argument is exhaustive computation rather than a symbolic case theorem.

originality.rationale: Brandt–Matthäus–Saile (2022) explicitly say in the Coombs subsection that their tie-independent convention makes no-show possible only with at least two abstainers. The audited ten-voter examples are tie-independent and use one abstainer, so they directly refute that restriction. Felsenthal's earlier witness uses fifteen voters and two like-minded abstainers. Fresh Resultary and exact-profile searches found no complete ten-voter/twelve-profile or thirteen-voter/eighteen-profile census.
residual_risks: An unindexed correction, thesis, note or software enumeration could contain the same finite census.

value.rationale: Participation is a standard social-choice axiom and Coombs is a canonical elimination rule. Correcting an explicit published restriction and completely classifying the first tie-independent standard no-show boundary is a motivated sharp finite result; the exactly-two variant also sharpens the historical witness.
residual_risks: An unindexed correction, thesis, note or software enumeration could contain the same finite census.

final_claim: For three-candidate Coombs voting with strict complete anonymous ballots and unique tie-independent outcomes, no standard homogeneous no-show event exists below ten voters; at ten voters exactly twelve labelled profiles admit one, all by one abstainer and in exactly two candidate-relabel classes. If exactly two identical abstainers are required, the sharp minimum is thirteen voters with eighteen profiles in three classes.
scientific_limitations: An unindexed correction, thesis, note or software enumeration could contain the same finite census.
